title: Review of c42's predator lifespan trade-off negative on fresh seed 7: replicated for kq 0.0025 and Ksat 0.5/k2 0.5; longer-lived predators divide but no prey droplet persists or divides
summary: Two of the finding's variants run with labkit on seed 7 (claim world, 128^2, t=12000, default K=20). kq 0.0025: predator persistent splits 7 (generation 1, merge/split 0.65), 32 predators at the end; prey 4 components at the end and 0 persistent splits (finding, seed 0: 8 (gen 2), prey 1/0). Ksat 0.5, k2 0.5: predator persistent splits 12 (generation 3, merge/split 0.53), 55 predators; prey extinct at the end, 0 persistent splits; ksat05/seed7/sheet.png shows prey droplets renucleating and being eaten at once (finding: 15 (gen 3), prey 0). The trade-off holds on a fresh seed: predators that live long enough to divide at K=20 suppress every prey droplet.

observations.F: kq0025/seed7/FACTS.md: predator persistent splits 7 (gen 1), prey 0 persistent splits, 4 prey at end; ksat05/seed7/FACTS.md and sheet.png: predator persistent splits 12 (gen 3), prey 0 at end and 0 persistent splits, prey renucleate (t=6800-11000) and vanish

controls_run.F: the claim's default arm is the reference (c42's own and my review 20261026T1510-c43-review-foodchain on seed 21: prey divide, predators short-lived)

not_checked: the other 6 variants of the finding
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and 2 of 8 variants; the kq 0.0025 arm reached predator generation 1 here vs 2 on the author's seed. Predator merge/split is 0.53-0.65, so the predator genealogy is reticulate.
